task_description: Rebuild JAY Network CLI Miner to use Puppeteer browser automation with injected Keplr wallet, replacing the direct WebSocket PoW approach.

verification.summary: npm install succeeds. CLI --help works. Wallet derivation produces correct yjay-prefixed address. Keplr mock generates valid script. BrowserMiner class loads and instantiates. Full flow test confirms browser launch, navigation, and challenge detection work correctly.
